blocks.text: TO THE ELECT BODY, THE SAINTS OF THE LIVING GOD, GREETINGS IN THE MAJESTY OF THE MOST HIGH, THE LORD JESUS,

“IN THIS SCRIPT WE WILL INTERPRET THE MYSTE- RIOUS LITTLE BOOK OF HABAKKUK! It was a prayer of triumph and also what he had heard and seen in a vision concerning the past, present and future!’’ — Hab. 3:2, ‘‘reveals he asked the Lord to revive thy work in the midst of years! Meaning His work of Salvation, Healing and Restoration! We are about to enter the same thing for our day soon! Notice he heard the Lord speak. He was given a terrifying experience of God’s creative power and judgments!’’ — ‘‘He said my belly trembled and my lips quivered at the voice!’’ (Verse 16) — ‘‘We will speak more on this awesome power in a moment!”’ Verse 3 illustrates ‘‘the prophet said he saw God come from Teman and the Holy One from Mount Paran! Evidently he meant he saw God moving across the desert from Mount Sinai! The prophet saw His brilliant splendor in the heavens, and the earth literally bubbling in praise!’’

HAB. 3:4, ‘REVEALS HIS CREATIVE AUTHORITY, His genuis power; it reveals His presence was in the brightness of tremendous light! And from His hands the prophet witnessed rays of brilliant flashing light! Evidently the prophet saw His hands without anything and then suddenly the hiding of His power leaped forth in dynamic beauty!’’ — Verse 5, ‘‘reveals that the pestilence and disease literally fled from him in terror, and burning fiery coals splashed around His feet! Plagues literally fled in His wake!’? — “The, prophet seemingly saw an in depth cosmic type glowing figure as Dan. 10:4-6 had seen; wherein His skin glowed and His eyes were deep set in fire!’’ — ‘‘Some in the Bible were literally blinded for a moment when seeing His flashing bright power!’’ — Hab. 3:6, ‘‘The prophet saw Him suddenly stop and in a moment measure the entire earth! No wonder he quivered. He witnessed the judgment of the earth before him in a moment’s time! Seems like a gigantic earthquake shook the whole earth like.’’ (Rev. 16:18) — ‘‘I rejoice in My power because I will help those humble who love Me in heart saith the Lord! Those will be co-heirs with Me!”’

HAB. 3:8, “WHEREIN IT SAYS THOU DIDST RIDE UPON THY HORSES (POWERS) and thy chariots of salvation! Meaning the prophet really saw chariots (or lights) of salvation representing true salvation!’’ — ‘‘We have actually photographed these lights of salvation; symbolic of God’s redemptive powers!’’ — Verse 10, “reveals power of authority, the deep uttered its voice, meaning creation and lifted up its hands in surrender, at Jesus’ command’’ (St. John 1:3-4)

HAB. 3:11, “REVEALS THE LORD HAD A SECRET WAY OF STOPPING THE SUN AND MOON IN THEIR COURSES! And at the brilliance of the Lord’s arrow type light they went, combined with something that looked like a glittering shining spear! The prophet may have seen a glowing type rod that God commanded these things done, or that the sun and the moon completely faded out from all of these bright attributes of power for a moment!’’ — Verses 12-13, ‘‘show the Lord just marched forth for the salvation of His people with judgment splashing in every direction while saving His people!’’ Verse 15, ‘‘reveals that God has some supernatural way of just going through the sea without any trouble at all with His army! The heap of great waters means that they just piled up on each side like giving military orders! Why not, He’s the captain of the Hosts, He’s the Chief Commander, but to us He is our dear friend and loves us!’’ — Verse 16, ‘“‘reveals all of this caused the prophet to tremble from head to toe!’’ — ‘‘Some of the things

found in this chapter concerning His attributes can be seen in Rev. | 4:5!’’ — Also the prophet in verse 16, at His voice the prophet felt a vileness in his bones! See the fullness of salvation as we know it today had not done its great work on the inside yet! Although the prophet was holy the flesh inside still revealed the need for the coming of the blood of the Messiah! to take the place of sacrifice of rams, lambs, etc. in finality!’’ (Rev. 5:9-10)

HAB. 3:16 HE LOOKED AT THE LORD INVADE THE EARTH! (LIKE AT ARMAGEDDON)— Now Verse 17, reveals the prophet’s great faith! — Even though the fruit trees and all the crops would be destroyed in famine we see a similar occurrence in our age (Rev. 6:6) ‘‘he said, yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation!’’ Verse 19, ‘‘he closes by saying, God was his strength; and he would allow him to walk safely in high places!’’ — ‘‘So we see this little book gave forth a glorious visitation! Let us remember He is on His way to redeem us, giving forth His divine love throughout the elect body!’’ Amen!

“THE LORD’S GLORY RESTORED IN THE TEMPLE THROUGH THE LORD JESUS!”’— First let’s start in Ezek. 1:1-5, ‘‘The heavens opened and the prophet saw visions of God! Notice ‘he saw God’ and other visions!’’ — Verse 4, ‘‘he looked and a whirlwind came out of a great cloud, and a fire was coming in and out of the cloud! And a brightness pulsated from it in the colour of amber! This was the coming of the glory of the Lord to enter the Temple among other things which we will read in a moment!’’ — ‘‘Some type of messengers stepped out of the cloud in the likeness of men.’’ (Verse 5) — Verses 27-28, ‘‘reveals the Lord later made His appearance out of the whirlwind too!’’ Ezek. 8:2, ‘‘reveals another startling appearance!’’ Ezek. 10:3-4, ‘‘reveals the Lord’s glory returning to the Temple! (In this manner He will return at the end of the age to the Gentile Temple!)’? — ‘‘Then later the Lord’s glory returns to the Millennium Temple the same as it did to the Gentile Temple before hand!”’

EZEK. 40:3, REVEALS A MAN WHOSE APPEARANCE WAS LIKE BRASS MEASURED IT! Read Ezek. 41:1— ‘‘We see evidently that this is the Millennium Temple where the Lord’s glory returns to the Hebrews!’’ Ezek. 43:2, ‘‘And his voice was like a noise of many waters, and the earth shined with His glory!’ — Verses 4-7, ‘‘reveals the glory of the Lord in the inner court and His house filled full of glory! Verse 7, shows His throne and rule to the Hebrews during this time!’? — ‘‘But before all this ‘the Gentile Temple’ will be filled with bright lights of the glory of the Lord and His presence similar to like it is in Ezek. chapter 10!’’ — ‘‘A great whirlwind of fire and glory is appearing to His children! We have literally seen and photographed His presence here, His divine love is wonderful! Be ready and watching for His great outpouring! Amen!”’

THE LORD INSPIRES ME TO PRINT THESE SCRIPTURES HERE— BEHOLD, THEY ARE TRUE! Rev. 2:17 ‘‘To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it/’’ — Verses 28, 29 ‘‘And I will give him the morning star! He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches!’’ — Rev. 3:4 ‘‘and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy!’’ Jude 1:14 ‘‘And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints.’’ Amen!
